text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Rush＞ ＜Raid＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Hybrid] Form.

qa.answer:
No, you cannot.
As this card has left the battle area, it doesn't have digivolution cards whose colors could be determined. Thus, the effect cannot be processed.
qa.question:
When I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect and my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area due to processing the 1st part, an immediate-type effect such as "when [...] would leave" removes this card from the battle area.
After that, can I process the part of the effect following after "then" in this card's effect?
